description: Pictogrammes des lignes de métro du réseau STAR is a dataset listed in STAR Data Explore open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by STAR. Liste des pictogrammes des lignes de métro du réseau STAR dans des résolutions différentes selon les usages nécessaires dans votre application. Coverage: Rennes Métropole (STAR network). The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are images, métro, ligne, pictogramme, couleur, star. The portal shows 12 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2014-12-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY-ND (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nd/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-explore-star-fr-portal.
